en: Black‑and‑white photograph of a large historic building in a courtyard setting, likely a palace or manor house. The structure has steep, tiled gabled roofs, ornate Baroque or late‑Renaissance gables, many rectangular windows, and ivy climbing the façade. On the right stands a central clock tower with a domed roof and lantern, topped by a weather vane. An arched gateway appears on the left, also decorated and framed by stone. Trees line the right side of the open courtyard in front of the building. The image is bordered in white like a printed postcard. No legible printed caption is visible.
